vb_textbox.text: hello! my advice for you is to start by exploring the forest with a random gnome. try to aim for collecting at least 4 mushrooms each time you visit the forest. stick with the gnome who consistently gives you this rate, but remember that the gnomes harvest rate can change within time randomly. be prepared to switch gnomes to achieve the best harvest ever in the game. i found out that the color of the gnomes hats did not make much difference, so focus more on the consistency of their harvest. always remember to hit the spacebar when the basket is full, as its easy to forget. good luck and happy mushroom hunting
